description:
JAE-HEE thought she'd be with her boyfriend forever. Turns out, he's not the man she thought he was! After breaking up with her boyfriend, guess who enters back into her life? Her childhood friend! Love triangles, drama and misunderstandings galore!

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Toptoon](https://toptoon.com/comic/ep_list/different_kiss), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/comic/ep_list/differentK)

**Official Translations:**  
[English](https://daycomics.com/content/100244)

The first kiss that failed, but if it were you!? The new love that appeared in front of Jae-hee who was hurt... By the way, that's Taehyun, her childhood friend...!
